findings.finding: The latest project control record keeps KM 0 OPEN and KM 1 IN_PROGRESS; KM 2+ are blocked until formal KM 1 acceptance. Main protection was previously reported NOT_APPLIED/NOT_VERIFIED.
findings.disposition: UEDE work may perform documentation and authorized read-only discovery. Do not use architecture acceptance or PR-level CI to bypass KM exit, branch protection or GOV-01 decisions.

findings.finding: PRE v0.1.1 is currently a USER/PRIVATE specification with no identified canonical Git source or declared license; shared runtime and capability-learning federation are SPECIFIED_NOT_DEPLOYED. The observed 20-record HSO Notion roadmap and HSO Mission Control database do not establish a deployed PRE API.
findings.disposition: P4 must begin as an explicitly named read-only adapter to the owner-authorized roadmap record, with revision, completeness and digest evidence. Do not claim a live PRE API.

findings.finding: Relevant HSO capabilities have varying source, license, instruction-parity and host-readiness states. SDO has 0/4 exact instruction matches; A.S.F.R.E.E is PolyForm Noncommercial with package/source drift; SKILL ANALYZER lacks a source license declaration and has package/instruction drift; Plugin Agent Orchestrator is source-unidentified.
findings.disposition: Keep capability discovery read-only. Require per-capability rights, immutable source, package parity, host and invocation evidence before any dispatch.

findings.finding: HSO's plan-only planner and sandbox runtime exist, but generic plugin.skill.invoke and generic mcp.remote.invoke remain NOT_CONFIGURED. Kestra and OpenHands are not deployed/connected as UEDE runtimes.
findings.disposition: Reuse the existing planner, keep generic invocation disabled, and require a synthetic end-to-end acceptance workflow before increasing autonomy.

findings.finding: The HSO PR graph contains work stacked on PR #15; current PR descriptions/roadmap records must remain aligned with the owner's latest explicit ordering. HSMART PR #30/#31 retain their own gates and must not be absorbed into UEDE.
findings.disposition: Do not retarget, merge or reorder existing PRs from this architecture change. Reconcile any conflicting dependency descriptions before a base-branch mutation.

merge_gates.required: The sole designated human authority records a decision against the exact final PR #32 and PR #25 heads.
Run Specification Validation, Repository Governance, KM1 Application Foundation and AI Reviewer Evidence on the final head; all required checks must be green.
Do not advance KM 2+ before formal KM 1 acceptance; apply/read back repository protection and satisfy the existing KM exit controls.
PR #25 must pass exact-head CI after its upstream PR/base dependencies are reconciled.
Architecture acceptance does not authorize adapter writes, engineering dispatch, merge, production access or autonomy expansion.

limitations: This is a correlation-limited architecture assurance report, not independent model/provider certification.
GOV-11 is a designated logical role; its separate runtime is not provisioned.
CI evidence listed as PASS is on the superseded pre-review head and cannot be used as final-head evidence.
The report does not constitute GOV-01 approval, GitHub-native APPROVED review, KM acceptance, security certification or runtime activation.
disposition: The proposed hybrid HSMART–HSO architecture and P0–P9 gated sequence are coherent with the inspected ownership model and can proceed to owner disposition as a documentation baseline with caveats.
